-- Phase 2: bodies for settings. Contracts are unchanged from Phase 1.
-- Lists have no push method, so lists grow by concatenation with `+`.
settings(keys: List[str], values: List[str]) -> List[str] =
  pre keys.len() == values.len()
  post out.len() >= 2
  ex settings([], []) == ["fast", "3"]
  ex settings(["mode"], ["slow"]) == ["slow", "3"]
  ex settings(["level", "x"], ["5", "1"]) == ["fast", "5", "1"]
  var mode = "fast"
  var level = "3"
  var others: List[str] = []
  for i in range(0, keys.len())
    if keys[i] == "mode"
      mode = copy values[i]
    else if keys[i] == "level"
      level = copy values[i]
    else
      others = others + [copy values[i]]
  [copy mode, copy level] + others
